hero.intro: I build real-time systems and websites that actually work for a business. From Antioquia, Colombia.
about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm studying Computer Engineering and I build software that has to survive production, not just look good in a demo.
about.p2: I work with React, Node.js, Python and WebSockets. I'm at my best on problems where state has to stay in sync across several clients at once: live scoring, control panels, internal tools that replace a shared spreadsheet.
about.p3: As an independent developer I've delivered websites and applications for real clients in Medellín, handling the full cycle: requirements, design, development, testing and deployment.
about.factAvailValue: Internships, full stack roles and freelance projects. Remote, on-site or hybrid.
work.title: Selected work
work.spartan.desc: Live scoreboard for taekwondo competitions. It syncs up to 4 judges with a central display over WebSockets, on desktop and mobile, with round management. Validated in a real pilot in May 2026.
work.flowy.desc: An assistant for websites that answers with each business's own information, collects contacts with their consent and hands off to WhatsApp when needed. It installs as a widget and is managed from a panel.
skills.title: Skills
skills.lead: What I use in my projects, grouped as in my CV. What I'm still learning is listed separately.
skills.langValue: Native Spanish. A2 English completed, studying B1; comfortable reading technical documentation.
